title_zh: 就社区花园关门时间达成试行折中

scenario.label_zh: 就社区花园关门时间达成试行折中
scenario.goal_zh: 说明分歧并商定本月工作日七点、周末八点关门的试行方案，同时保留月底复核

context_zh: 社区花园两位轮值管理员得到各自小组授权，商议本月试行的关门时间。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: The point of contention is still the closing time. Your group wants eight every night; ours wants six.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Could a compromise be seven on weekdays and eight at weekends?

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: I concede that six is too early for people coming from work, but our weekday volunteer leaves at seven.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Seven on weekdays is a concession we can accept. Could your group cover eight at weekends?

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: We can cover that for this month. We would need to review the workload afterwards.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Then do we have a consensus on seven during the week and eight at weekends, with a review at the end of the month?

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Yes. I'll tell our rota organiser those trial hours and the review date.

targets.sense_zh: 承认原先未接受的观点
